texts.preamble: Manish Chaurasiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 January, 2026 Author: Gurpal Singh Ahluwalia Bench: Gurpal Singh Ahluwalia 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Gwalior Msa No. 88 of 2025 (Manish Chaurasiya And Others Vs The State Of Dated : 14-01-2026 Shri G.P. Chourasiya - Advocate for appellants. Shri C.P. Singh - Government Advocate for the State.
texts.facts: It is the case of prosecution that without any registration/license, appellants were involved in transportation of Shyam Gold Ghee and Sajal Ghee. Appellants were under obligation to obtain license/registration under the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulation, 2011, but appellants were transporting the ghee NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:7885 2 MSA-88-2025 without any registration/license, and thus, they have violated the provisions of Section 31(2) of the FSSA.
texts.arguments: 4. It is fairly conceded by counsel for appellants that appellants were not having any registration/license for transportation of ghee. 5. Per contra, appeal is vehemently opposed by counsel for State, but he could not point out as to how a penalty of Rs. 1,00,000/- can be imposed in the light of the proviso to Section 50 of the FSSA.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 4. It is fairly conceded by counsel for appellants that appellants were not having any registration/license for transportation of ghee. 5. Per contra, appeal is vehemently opposed by counsel for State, but he could not point out as to how a penalty of Rs. 1,00,000/- can be imposed in the light of the proviso to Section 50 of the FSSA.
